theorems.name: Submission.bv_integral_div_le_of_variation_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → Chapter02.bvVariationOn u W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c → ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Rn n) (Rn n), Chapter02.IsC1TestField g → tsupport g ⊆ W → (∫ x in W, u x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (g : Rn n → Rn n) x) ≤ c * Chapter02.compactlySupportedSupNorm g
